claims.text: The load-generator, frontend-proxy, frontend, checkout, and payment services exhibit error spans associated with HTTP 422 errors and gRPC status code 13 during checkout operations.
Trace spans show that execution flows from frontend through CheckoutService/PlaceOrder to PaymentService/Charge, where payment service generates errors.
PlaceOrder prepares the order, invokes PaymentService.Charge, and handles errors, while frontend maps failed place order responses with specific prefixes to HTTP 422.

The payment service or its internal charge logic could be the origin of the failure, causing checkout and frontend services to surface downstream error responses rather than initiating the fault themselves.
Static source context and error spans do not confirm that the payment failure is due to an internal bug or an unverified deployed runtime image version.

uncertainties: The exact internal error message and stack trace within PaymentService/Charge.
Whether the deployed container image matches the pinned source code version.
next_checks: Inspect the container logs and standard error streams of the payment service during the incident timeframe.
Verify the deployed version and environment variable configuration of the payment and checkout services.
